plainTranslation: Venus square Jupiter: Venus square Jupiter, you can still get along fairly well, but you may be lazy in the relationship, and if problems arise, you may feel that you don’t need to deal with them, so you have to force yourselves to take action when required.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
